K4-Specialists — Complete Codex role invocation and result parity

source.description:
## PROBLEM
XT Codex parity needs a native Specialists render and role surface that is distinct from existing Pi-backed openai-codex model execution.

## SUCCESS
Add a Codex surface with valid role, view, render, help, model, and $skill-name semantics. Produce a backward-compatible compatibility release before Core publishes the production launcher.

## SCOPE
This root owns only Specialists repository changes for K1 characterization, K3-Specialists, K4 invocation/result completion, test coverage, and the K6 sibling compatibility release.

## NON_GOALS
Do not implement the Core interactive launcher, xtmux lifecycle domains, native Codex subagents, or a direct codex exec backend as a parity prerequisite. Direct Codex execution remains optional K7 work.

## CONSTRAINTS
Keep interactive Codex surface identity separate from provider IDs such as openai-codex/.... Preserve Pi and Claude render behavior. Use repository-local children only. Represent Core, xtmux, Jira, and programme gates as external references or companion relations.

## VALIDATION
Run focused unit and integration tests for surface resolution, rendering, $skill-name syntax, role/model validation, and result retrieval. Prove no regression in Pi/Claude rendering and no accidental provider-ID aliasing.

## OUTPUT
A repository-owned companion graph related to Core xtrm-ozknq and Jira KAN-127. Canonical sequencing note: https://github.com/xtrm-dev/xtrm/blob/ed06ba222307030c7153c43cd2370262706b78a4/docs/shared/xtrm-codex-kan-127-execution-note.md

source.description:
## PROBLEM
Core must not publish a production launcher against Specialists behavior that exists only on a branch.

## SUCCESS
Publish a backward-compatible Specialists compatibility release containing the accepted K3/K4 native Codex surface before the Core launcher release.

## SCOPE
Versioning, changelog, package publication, compatibility metadata, and post-publish render/invocation verification.

## NON_GOALS
Do not publish Core or xtmux, add direct codex exec, or introduce optional K7 capabilities.

## CONSTRAINTS
Execute only after K5 promotion authorization. Remain compatible with the current Core line and any contract-only Core package published earlier.

## VALIDATION
Verify package contents, registry version, clean install, render/role fixtures, backward compatibility, and the exact version handed to Core K6.

## OUTPUT
A published Specialists version and immutable release evidence consumed by Core K6.

source.description:
## PROBLEM
The external Core K5 edge is persisted but not enforced by the local ready view without federation.

## SUCCESS
Close only after Core xtrm-ozknq.11 records an approved production promotion.

## SCOPE
Read-only Core promotion evidence check after Specialists K4.

## NON_GOALS
Do not decide parity from Specialists or publish before authorization.

## CONSTRAINTS
Record the Core gate decision, GATE-IFACE evidence reference, parity matrix reference, and compatible versions.

## VALIDATION
Verify Core K5 is closed as promoted, not rejected or waived.

## OUTPUT
A local synchronization gate that blocks the Specialists compatibility release.
